what: Three or more sentences stacked in one spot switch every 3.8s — the current sentence’s words slide up and out starting from the front at .03s intervals (−105%, .35s power3.in), and the next sentence’s words rise in from 105% below at .04s intervals (.4s power3.out). After the last it returns to the first and loops endlessly. It pauses when off screen

options.[data-fx-part=phrase]: Sentences to overlap — two or more. Inside, [data-fx-part=If word] is attached, it is kept as one chunk, otherwise it is split on spaces
options.look: rise: Sentence by sentence, not split into words — the current sentence hides immediately and the next one rises in from .5em below and transparent over in (default 1s) with ease (default 0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94 — ease-out-quad), every default 3
options.ease: look: floating-up curve for rise — a GSAP name or ”0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94”

use: Your achievement sentence hereYour achievement sentence two hereYour achievement sentence three here

from.where: index.html .tw-stats (original three result sentences in the hero: exit .35 power3.in .03 · rise after .37 for .4 power3.out .04, 3.8s beat)
index.js [data-fg-rotate] second About sentence — original Statements (animation_interval 3 · duration 1: enter transform · opacity 1s ease-out-quad delayed .01s, exit opacity 0s · visibility 1s)
